```python
import requests

API_KEY = "secret123"
DOMAIN   = "sample.com"
URL      = f"https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/{DOMAIN}/dns_records?record_type=CNAME"

headers = {"x-apikey": API_KEY}
response = requests.get(URL, headers=headers)
data     = response.json()

ids = [item["id"] for item in data.get("data", [])]
print(ids)   # e.g., ['id1', 'id2']
```
